sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout searched llm-agent, llm-post-training and ai-safety, returned a unified current-week table, and ranked GPT-Red first.

Main agent read the arXiv abstract, HTML full text and PDF, extracted self-play algorithm, defender_model harness, red-teaming RL environments, GPT-5.6 evaluation protocol, headline robustness numbers and reproducibility boundaries.

Article avoids executable prompt-injection payloads, separates internal-system evidence from externally reproducible claims, and states that model weights, full environments and production harnesses are not public.
